summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K on 12 August 2026 disclosing routine PDMR share transactions under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. The filing reports the vesting of 2023 performance share awards under the Global Share Plan 2020, with shares sold to cover tax liabilities. Rohit Kashyap, President of Advanced Wound Management, had 23,202 shares vest at £11.096264 per share, of which 9,163 were sold and 14,039 retained. This is an administrative disclosure of equity compensation vesting, not a special-situation corporate event. No board action, advisory role, or transaction terms beyond the share vest apply. What to watch: none; this is routine insider equity activity with no strategic implications.
